stories.title: Define experience measure schema and contract
stories.description: Create data contract for provider experience including fields for graduation_year, enumeration_date, derived_years_in_practice, and normalized_experience_score. Extend provider detail response model to include this measure.

stories.title: Implement years-in-practice calculation logic
stories.description: Build core logic to derive years in practice using NPI enumeration_date and/or graduation_year if available. Include fallback handling when one or both fields are missing and compute normalized score based on defined ranges.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/domain/evaluate_care_quality/provider_detail_service.py (NPI Registry CMS API lookup provides enumeration_date)

stories.title: Integrate experience measure into provider detail API
stories.description: Update provider_detail_service and evaluate_care_facade to include computed experience measure in API responses. Ensure compatibility with existing tool models and response formatting.

stories.title: Unit and integration tests for experience measure
stories.description: Create tests validating years-in-practice calculations, fallback logic, and API response inclusion. Cover edge cases such as missing enumeration_date, future dates, and extreme values.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests/ (existing backend test patterns for services and facades)
